name: Timewatch
description: Set how long you have and get watch suggestions that fit the time left, replacing Jellyfin's native Up Next popup until your time is up.
overview: Watch suggestions that fit the time you actually have.

versions.changelog:
First working release.

- Start a watch window from /Timewatch/Start: pick a duration, see the time
  left, cancel it. Works for any user, not just admins.
- Near the end of an episode a small popup names the best-fitting thing to
  watch next, with "Start now" and "Choose...". It does not cover the video.
- The end card opens on "Choose..." or when the episode ends: suggestions
  labelled with how long they run and what they would leave. Picking one
  plays it; dismissing one marks it watched and refills the slot.
- A suggestion only appears if the time left after it can also be filled, so
  you are never left with an unusable gap.
- The episode Jellyfin would have played next comes first whenever it fits.
- While a window is active, Jellyfin's own Up Next overlay and auto-advance
  are suppressed, and restored when the window ends.
- When the time is up the card says so and offers nothing. There is no
  extend button, by design.

Requires the File Transformation plugin, which Jellyfin cannot install for
you. Reaches browsers, Jellyfin Desktop, LG webOS, Android mobile and iOS;
not Samsung/Tizen, Android TV, Roku, Kodi or Swiftfin.
